title: GPT-4o (OpenAI) — multimodal flagship
description: GPT-4o is OpenAI's multimodal flagship: one model that takes text and images in and produces text out, with a Realtime API variant that also speaks and listens. It was trained end-to-end across text, vision, and audio, so it reasons over a chart image or a photo with the same weights it uses for prose. The 128K-token context window fits long documents and extended conversations, and it remains the default workhorse for general assistants, copilots, and multimodal apps built on the OpenAI platform.
best_for: General chat, multimodal apps, vision Q&A, and anything needing a strong all-rounder with image input.

demo.code:
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI()  # reads OPENAI_API_KEY
resp = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="gpt-4o",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": [
        {"type": "text", "text": "Describe the trend in this chart."},
        {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "https://example.com/chart.png"}},
    ]}],
    max_tokens=300,
)
print(resp.choices[0].message.content)
demo.notes: Real OpenAI SDK pattern. Needs an OPENAI_API_KEY; image URL must be reachable.

provenance: Public model cards, provider documentation, and open model repository metadata.

title: o3 (OpenAI) — reasoning model
description: o3 is OpenAI's reasoning-series model: instead of answering immediately it spends extra compute thinking through a private chain of thought, which makes it far stronger on math, science, coding, and multi-step planning than same-size chat models. You steer the trade-off with the reasoning_effort parameter — low for quick answers, high for hard problems. It accepts image input too, so it can reason over diagrams and screenshots before answering.
strengths: State-of-the-art reasoning on hard STEM tasks
best_for: Hard math, competitive programming, science questions, and planning problems where accuracy beats speed.

demo.code:
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI()
resp = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="o3",
    reasoning_effort="high",
    messages=[{"role": "user",
               "content": "A train leaves at 2pm at 60mph, another at 3pm at 80mph same direction. When does the second catch the first? Show work."}],
)
print(resp.choices[0].message.content)
demo.notes: Real OpenAI SDK pattern for the reasoning series.

provenance: Public model cards, provider documentation, and open model repository metadata.

title: DALL-E 3 (OpenAI) — text-to-image
description: DALL-E 3 is OpenAI's text-to-image model, notable for following long, detailed prompts far more faithfully than earlier diffusion models — it renders text in images, respects spatial relationships ('a red cube on top of a blue sphere'), and handles complex scenes from paragraph-length descriptions. It is available inside ChatGPT, where the chat model helps refine prompts, and through the Images API for programmatic generation at 1024x1024, 1792x1024, or 1024x1792.
best_for: Marketing visuals, storyboards, concept art, and any image where the prompt wording must be obeyed.

demo.code:

client = OpenAI()
img = client.images.generate(
    model="dall-e-3",
    prompt="A lighthouse at dusk, waves crashing, painterly style",
    size="1024x1024", quality="standard", n=1,
)
print(img.data[0].url)
demo.notes: Real OpenAI Images API pattern. Returns a hosted URL (or b64_json).

provenance: Public model cards, provider documentation, and open model repository metadata.

title: Whisper large-v3 (OpenAI) — speech recognition
description: Whisper large-v3 is OpenAI's open-weight automatic speech recognition model, trained on 5 million hours of multilingual audio. It transcribes 99 languages, translates non-English speech to English, and timestamps words — all from a single encoder-decoder Transformer. Because the weights are open, anyone can self-host it; because the API exists, anyone can also call it without a GPU. It set the standard that every open STT model since has been measured against.
best_for: Transcription pipelines, subtitles, voice interfaces, and multilingual STT without API lock-in.

        model="whisper-1", file=f,
        response_format="verbose_json", timestamp_granularities=["word"],
    )
print(tr.text)
# Self-hosted alternative: pip install openai-whisper, then whisper interview.mp3 --model large-v3
demo.notes: Real OpenAI Audio API pattern; comment shows the open-weight CLI route.

title: Claude Opus 4 (Anthropic) — flagship reasoning hybrid
description: Claude Opus 4 is Anthropic's most capable model: a hybrid that can answer instantly or think at length with extended thinking, and use tools while it thinks. It leads on coding benchmarks among public models, follows long-horizon agentic instructions reliably, and keeps a 200K-token context. Anthropic positions it as the model for sustained, complex work — multi-file refactors, research agents, and workflows where the model must stay on task for hundreds of steps.
strengths: Extended thinking + tool use while thinking
best_for: Complex coding, long-running agents, and hard analytical work where quality matters most.

title: Gemini 2.5 Pro (Google) — 1M-context thinking model

It is natively multimodal (text, image, audio, video in), tops reasoning benchmarks, and is available free-tier through AI Studio and at scale through Vertex AI. It generates photorealistic images with strong prompt adherence and notably good rendering of text inside images. Google pairs it with SynthID watermarking, so generated images carry an invisible provenance mark — a practical plus for publishers and brands that need to track AI-generated assets.

title: Veo 3 (Google) — video with native audio
description: Veo 3 is Google's video-generation model and the first major one to generate synchronized audio — dialogue, sound effects, ambient sound — along with the video itself. Clips come out at high fidelity with realistic physics and lip-synced speech, which collapsed the old two-step 'generate silent video, add audio later' pipeline into a single prompt. It is served through the Gemini API and Vertex AI for creators and studios.
best_for: Short films, ads, and product videos where sound must match the picture.

demo.code:

    model="veo-3.0-generate-001",
    prompt="A drone shot over a coastal town at golden hour, waves and gull sounds",
)
while not op.done: op = client.operations.get(op)
print("video ready:", op.response is not None)
demo.notes: Real Google Veo API pattern (long-running operation polling).
